name: Copper Creek Event Center
description: A ballroom reception venue in Springville with mountain views, a prep kitchen, integrated sound, projection and flexible seating.
seatedText:
Seated dinner 130 preferred, 160 max
Buffet dinner 120–140

Features > Cleanup crew.wording: Staff handle tables, chairs, linens and floor cleaning

Features > Event coordinator.wording: Ceremony coordinator, $125 (venue host is not a wedding coordinator)

Features > Linens included.wording: Linens for 9 round tables, color of choice

Features > Sparklers allowed.wording: Sparkler packages: 50 for $40, 100 for $70–$75; staff hand out, light and dispose

Other > Cake table.wording: Cake table with linen, cake stand and cutting utensils

items.label: Description
items.value: A ballroom reception venue in Springville with mountain views, a prep kitchen, integrated sound, projection and flexible seating.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Weekday (Mon-Wed): 10am-3pm — $1,800; 5pm-10pm — $2,250; 10am-10pm — $3,000
Prime (Thu-Sat): 10am-3pm — $2,150; 5pm-10pm — $2,750; 10am-10pm — $4,200
Every rental includes 90 chairs, 9 60-inch round tables with linens, cake table with linen, cake stand and cutting utensils, personalized entry sign, sign-in table, 2 banquet tables with linens, setup/takedown of tables and chairs, prep kitchen, ice machine, floor easels, bride's dressing room, sound system, projector and screen, wireless microphone and stand, venue host/hostess
Ceremony coordination — $125
Full decor closet (staff set up and take down) — $150
Client personal decor setup — $100
Wooden or circle arch backdrop — $75
Additional linens — $20
Additional table with linen and chairs — $60
Sparkler package, 50 count — $40
Sparkler package, 100 count — $70 (FAQ says $75)
Garden room overflow — $400
Ceremony transition fee for groups over 90 — $100

items.label: Seated
items.value:
Seated dinner 130 preferred, 160 max
Buffet dinner 120–140

items.label: Layouts
items.value: Layout: Open house · Seats: 90-120 · Invite: up to 400

items.label: Linens included
items.value: Linens for 9 round tables, color of choice

items.label: Cleanup crew
items.value: Staff handle tables, chairs, linens and floor cleaning

items.label: Event coordinator
items.value: Ceremony coordinator, $125 (venue host is not a wedding coordinator)

items.label: Included items
items.value:
90 guest chairs
9 round 60-inch tables with dining linens
Cake table with linen
Cake stand and cutting utensils
Personalized digital entry sign and directional signs
Sign-in table
2 banquet tables with linens
Floor easels
5 drink dispensers

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value: Ceremony coordinator — $125 (the venue host/hostess is not a coordinator)

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Included
Staff take down tables, chairs and linens and clean the floors
Client clears table trash to the dumpsters and cleans the kitchen ($100 fee if left dirty)

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Integrated surround sound system (client provides the music device)
Projector and large screen
1 wireless microphone and stand

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Full decor closet (set up and taken down by staff) — $150
Wooden or golden circle arch backdrop — $75
Additional linens — $20
Additional table with linen and chairs — $60

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Venue host/hostess on site (not a wedding coordinator)
Ceremony coordination — $125
Client personal decor setup — $100
Garden room overflow — $400
In-house florist Ben & Annie Flowers (client discounts)
Extra hour before or after the rental when available

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Cake table with linen, cake stand and cutting utensils

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Own caterer or self-catering allowed (no required vendors)
Kitchen use fee without a licensed caterer — $120 (FAQ says $125)
Preferred caterer list available

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Prep kitchen (no oven, stove or freezer)
Refrigerator
Pebble ice machine
Microwave
Sinks

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Alcohol prohibited on the space and property
$200 fee and confiscation if alcohol is found

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Sparkler packages: 50 for $40, 100 for $70–$75; staff hand out, light and dispose

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
Yes
Sparkler packages: 50 count — $40; 100 count — $70 (FAQ: $75); staff hand out, light and dispose

items.label: Times
items.value:
Mon-Wed 10am-3pm
Mon-Wed 5pm-10pm
Mon-Wed 10am-10pm
Thu-Sat 10am-3pm
Thu-Sat 5pm-10pm
Thu-Sat 10am-10pm
Shorter events: 3-hour minimum at an hourly rate

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Alcohol prohibited on the space and property
Live-flame candles only through in-house florist Ben & Annie Flowers; other candles must be faux
No confetti or glitter (rice paper allowed)
Nothing attached to the walls
Lights or drapery hung only by a licensed, insured company
Family-friendly music only
Building must be vacated at rental end ($200 per extra half-hour)
Bussing tables is the caterer's or client's responsibility

items.label: Accessibility
items.value:
Wheelchair accessible
Elevator just inside the main entrance

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Sparkler 100-count price: pricing page $70, FAQ $75
Kitchen use fee: pricing page $120, FAQ $125
No dedicated groom's room
Open house style: seating for 90-120, invite up to 400
1-2 staff on site during every event
